resolvedReviewFindings: Removed rejected machine-specific OTAMH2 paths, bundle IDs, and executable hashes from governed source. Reuse now requires an explicit portable sealed identity record bootstrapped from an existing owned fictional harness root.
Closed the identity transaction gap before the active state, added directory fsync, rejected equal candidate and original inventories, and covered interrupted stages and physical-state recovery.

Moved record type checks before reads so FIFO and symlink records fail closed. Exact CFBundleName, bundle identifier, ownership, regular-file types, complete inventory, and executable hashes are validated.
Changed attachment hdiutil observations to exclusive unique evidence files. The earlier deterministic same-second collision remains recorded rather than hidden.
Added post-sign bundled CLI execution and recursive packaged classifier inventory verification.

Hardened the private translation helper against profile symlink escape and required canonical owned mode-0700 roots, nonsymlink markers, sealed full inventories, journal digests, and exact PID commands.
Rejected IMAP and SMTP port zero and required exact loopback TLS SMTP host, port, and server name for both fictional accounts.
Replaced fail-open process probing with running, absent, and probe-error states. Only an explicit absent result permits restoration.

Kept the H016 hold active until a valid release sentinel and an absent candidate probe. Signals, timeouts, malformed release files, and process probe errors retain the transaction for explicit recovery.
Derived the per-run WebKit data-store identifier from the main Tauri config instead of a second environment source, and required an exact random version-4 UUID under the fictional feature gate.
Corrected the handoff record to publish a newline byte in expectedReleaseContent. The validator rejects the previous literal backslash-n value.

Replaced the rejected process-stop preparation with a nonce-owned fictional IMAP proxy hold. Duration is bounded to 100 through 35000 milliseconds, the same in-process release path serves explicit and automatic resume, and control never signals a stored PID.
